prompts.wallpaper:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished landscape 16:9 wallpaper for Yggdrasil Shogi, image only.
Primary request: A magnificent natural, mythological Yggdrasil ash tree in an ancient Nordic landscape at blue hour, with a believable enormous gnarled trunk, twisting exposed roots gripping mossy rock, a wide irregular canopy of many finely branching limbs and abundant delicate ash leaves, mist drifting through a fjord valley and distant mountains, stars and a restrained northern light. The tree must feel alive, ancient, organic and awe-inspiring rather than a diagram or logo.
Style/medium: richly textured fantasy landscape painting with naturalistic tree anatomy, soft atmospheric depth, sophisticated midnight indigo and muted teal with warm moonlit gold catching bark, leaves and water. Reference is the user's Celestial Dragon image: take its lush material texture, blue-gold richness, mythological scale and cinematic landscape mood, but make an original Norse scene with a living tree; no dragon, paper-cut clouds, copied composition, or hard gold outlines.
Composition/framing: wide landscape, entire broad canopy and root structure visible, roots and fine branches naturally asymmetrical; distant water and mist give a calm lower third behind game UI. Full bleed polished artwork, no frame.
Constraints: no words, no lettering, no runic text, no watermark, no circles, no geometric tree, no UI, no board grid.
prompts.board:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square 1:1 full-bleed background for the PLAYING SURFACE of a shogi board; image only.
Primary request: A natural pale ash-wood board surface with fine, realistic subtle flowing grain in warm parchment and softly weathered honey, lightly adorned with a beautifully hand-carved Norse ash tree bough with recognizable compound ash leaves in the top left outer corner and a few gracefully curling carved roots in the bottom right outer corner. A refined craft object, not a scene or a landscape.
Materials/textures: softly polished light solid ash wood, smooth playable surface, faint tactile grain. Shallow warm-grey carved lines with tiny honey highlights, botanical and organic rather than geometric.
Composition/framing: perfectly flat straight-on square texture, no perspective, no photograph of a board on a table; all ornament confined to outermost 12 percent near the corners, visibly drawn but restrained. Central 80 percent is a very even, pale, low-contrast, low-detail field so black grid lines and medium brown wood pieces read clearly. No central tree emblem. The user's Moonlit Cranes board is a reference for calm legibility and tasteful corner illustration, not to be copied.
Constraints: no baked-in grid, no squares, no game pieces, no frame, no borders, no text, no runic text, no logos, no watermark, no dark vignette.
